name: $hasVoted
description: Asks Top.gg whether a user voted for the bot in the last 12 hours. Fails with an error when the request fails, so use $try for a fallback

args.name: user ID
args.description: The user to check: an ID or a mention

name: $isVoteWeekend
description: Asks Top.gg whether the weekend multiplier is active (votes count twice). Fails with an error when the request fails, so use $try for a fallback

name: $monthlyVotes
description: Gets the votes of the bot this month from Top.gg. Fails with an error when the request fails, so use $try for a fallback

name: $totalVotes
description: Gets the total votes of the bot from Top.gg. Fails with an error when the request fails, so use $try for a fallback

name: $sendTestVote
description: Sends a test vote to the bot's own running webhook, the way Top.gg does, and returns the HTTP status (204 when it was accepted). The voted event runs with $voteType test; nothing is stored

args.name: user ID
args.description: The voter (an ID or a mention), defaults to the author

args.name: weekend
args.description: Whether to mark the vote as a weekend vote (legacy webhooks only)

args.name: query
args.description: Query string of the vote page, e.g. ref=abc (legacy webhooks only)

name: $lastVoteTime
description: Returns when the user last voted (ms timestamp) as recorded by the webhook, empty if no vote was recorded

args.name: user ID
args.description: The user (an ID or a mention), defaults to the voter in vote events and to the author elsewhere

name: $nextVoteTime
description: Returns when the user can vote again (ms timestamp) as recorded by the webhook, empty if no vote was recorded

args.name: user ID
args.description: The user (an ID or a mention), defaults to the voter in vote events and to the author elsewhere

name: $voteCount
description: Returns how many votes of the user the webhook recorded (test votes excluded)

args.name: user ID
args.description: The user (an ID or a mention), defaults to the voter in vote events and to the author elsewhere

name: $votePoints
description: Returns the recorded votes of the user with weekend votes counted twice

args.name: user ID
args.description: The user (an ID or a mention), defaults to the voter in vote events and to the author elsewhere

name: $voteStreak
description: Returns how many times in a row the user voted, each vote at most streakGrace (12 hours by default) after they could vote again; 0 once the streak is broken

args.name: user ID
args.description: The user (an ID or a mention), defaults to the voter in vote events and to the author elsewhere

name: $votedWithin
description: Returns whether the webhook recorded a vote of the user within the given time, without asking Top.gg

args.name: duration
args.description: How far back to look, e.g. 12h or 1d

args.name: user ID
args.description: The user (an ID or a mention), defaults to the voter in vote events and to the author elsewhere

name: $postStatsError
description: Returns the error message, in the error event

name: $postedServerCount
description: The server count that was posted

name: $postedShardCount
description: The amount of shards that was posted

name: $postedShardID
description: The main shard id that was posted

name: $voteBotID
description: Returns the ID of the bot that was voted for, in the voted event (empty for server votes)

name: $voteGuildID
description: Returns the ID of the server that was voted for, in the voted event (empty for bot votes)

name: $voteIsWeekend
description: Returns whether the weekend multiplier was active for the vote (it counts twice)

name: $voteQuery
description: Returns the query parameters of the vote page URL as JSON, or one parameter's value

args.name: key
args.description: The parameter to return, e.g. ref for ?ref=abc

name: $voteTimestamp
description: Returns when the vote was cast (ms timestamp)

name: $voteType
description: Returns the type of the vote, upvote for a real vote or test for the test button

name: $voteUserID
description: Returns the ID of the user who voted, in the voted event

name: $voteWeight
description: Returns how many votes the vote counts as, 2 during Top.gg's weekend multiplier, otherwise 1
